label: PF Backlog 220
title: Backend: tool/SDK/vendor catalog with license metadata + bundle_allowed (feeds packaging & PR gate)
body:
## Problem / why
We choose tools/models but have no machine-readable record of their license, so we cannot prove that
only redistributable components get bundled, and packaging/review cannot enforce it.

## Goal & value
A single catalog (config/tool-catalog.json) of every tool/SDK/vendor + generator with license class and
`bundle_allowed`, consumed by selection, packaging, and the PR/pre-check gate.

## In scope
- Schema per entry: name, kind, modality, license_id, license_class
  (permissive|weak-copyleft|strong-copyleft|network-copyleft|restricted|proprietary), bundle_allowed,
  source (pypi/system/api), version pin, notes.
- Seed from docs/tools-and-generators.md (tools, models, APIs).
- **Packaging hook:** fail the build if a bundled artifact's license_class is not bundle_allowed.
- **PR/pre-check hook (BI-0205):** adding a dependency requires a catalog entry (else the check fails).
- `bundle_allowed` also gates model weights (ties to BI-0206 license gate).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every bundled tool/model resolves to a catalog entry with a license_class.
- Packaging fails on a non-bundle_allowed component; passes when only permissive/LGPL-unmodified.
- Adding an unlisted dependency fails the pre-check until catalogued.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: license_class decision table; catalog lookup.
- Integration: a synthetic non-bundle_allowed entry blocks packaging; removing it passes.
